# AAF reference fixture

`aaf-sdk-export-as05-effects.aaf.xz` is the deterministic, essence-free output
of the AAF SDK reference implementation's `ExportAS05Effects` example at
commit `59eea610c86314d40e4611b599dd5bba9b76badd`.

It contains the AS-05 Video Color, Video Title, and Video Opacity operation
dictionaries and ConstantValue parameters. The uncompressed AAF SHA-256 is
`6c57cad838a466c6fc98b30dfc7144f66b0895079bacc09232663668a460d453`.
The compressed fixture SHA-256 is
`6b1699454165e2e17c4eee1e9c52c126a61a8bc9e53c59d701f71da2815cd9c4`.

The generator source is distributed under the AAF SDK Public Source License
2.0; see the upstream `AAFSDKPSL.TXT`. This generated data file contains no SDK
source or executable code, media essence, or third-party user content.
